### Marcus Corporation to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences


September 9, 2026


MILWAUKEE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Marcus Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.marcuscorp.com&esheet=54600768&newsitemid=20260908367470&lan=en-US&anchor=Marcus+Corporation&index=1&md5=c16e6f09668c0c39d09c06cfb828f608) (NYSE: MCS) today announced that Chad M. Paris, chief financial officer and treasurer, will participate in two upcoming investor conferences this month.


**StoneX 13th Annual Tech, Media & Telecom Conference**


Mr. Paris will participate in StoneX's 13th Annual Tech, Media & Telecom Conference on Thursday, September 17, 2026, in New York City. The conference features one-on-one meetings. Meetings with Mr. Paris can be scheduled through StoneX. For more information, please visit[stonex.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.stonex.com&esheet=54600768&newsitemid=20260908367470&lan=en-US&anchor=stonex.com&index=2&md5=2353c51195efc25ad67825e232aa0507) .


**19th Annual Barrington Research Virtual Fall Investment Conference**


Mr. Paris will also participate in the 19th Annual Barrington Research Virtual Fall Investment Conference on Tuesday, September 22, 2026. The conference consists of private one-on-one and small group video conference calls between company management teams and investors. Meetings with Mr. Paris can be scheduled through Barrington Research Associates. For more information, please visit[brai.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fbrai.com%2F&esheet=54600768&newsitemid=20260908367470&lan=en-US&anchor=brai.com&index=3&md5=78dddfce01f7c4bc4b1e4c9b1ca65767) .


**About Marcus Corporation**


Headquartered in Milwaukee,[Marcus Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.marcuscorp.com%2F&esheet=54600768&newsitemid=20260908367470&lan=en-US&anchor=Marcus+Corporation&index=4&md5=83d9f1e35498a5fbcbc59ccf60a17fec) is a leader in the entertainment and hospitality industries, with significant company-owned real estate assets. Marcus Corporation’s theatre division,[Marcus Theatres®](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.marcustheatres.com%2F&esheet=54600768&newsitemid=20260908367470&lan=en-US&anchor=Marcus+Theatres%26%23174%3B&index=5&md5=6c4fccb6a6a611937110979a001eba4e) , is the fourth largest theatre circuit in the U.S. and currently owns or operates 975 screens at 77 locations in 17 states under the Marcus Theatres, Movie Tavern® by Marcus and Bistro *Plex* ® brands. The company’s hospitality division,[Marcus® Hotels & Resorts](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.marcushotels.com%2F&esheet=54600768&newsitemid=20260908367470&lan=en-US&anchor=Marcus%26%23174%3B+Hotels+%26amp%3B+Resorts&index=6&md5=b3b45525ed995fdda175e487bf402e95) , owns and/or manages 17 hotels, resorts and other properties in eight states. For more information, please visit the company’s website at[www.marcuscorp.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.marcuscorp.com%2F&esheet=54600768&newsitemid=20260908367470&lan=en-US&anchor=www.marcuscorp.com&index=7&md5=046b7838fa3641f703507586645bf8c7) .
